title: dbt and analytics engineering
description: Conventions for dbt and analytics engineering.

rules.title: Staging, intermediate, marts
rules.text: Layer models as staging, intermediate and marts with one-to-one staging per source table.

rules.title: Test every model
rules.text: Add unique, not_null and relationship tests to every key.

rules.title: Use ref and source
rules.text: Reference models with ref() and raw tables with source(), never hardcoded names.

rules.title: Incremental models carefully
rules.text: Use incremental models for large tables with a reliable unique key.

rules.title: Document models
rules.text: Describe models and columns in schema files.
